topic: The 'Reject all' button that didn't — CNIL's €150M Shein decision

drafts.text: AUDIT: Shein's 'Reject all' button (Sept 2025) — click registered, cookies didn't stop. New ones fired, old ones kept reading. CNIL: €150M. A working button and functioning consent are not the same claim. Reproducible pattern, playable now: https://data-snack.com/snack/cookie-roulette
